scriptLines: limpiarTextos derive(department = case(startsWith(claveDepto, 'gen'), 'General Surgery', startsWith(claveDepto, 'card'), 'Cardiology', startsWith(claveDepto, 'neu') || startsWith(claveDepto, 'nue'), 'Neurology', startsWith(claveDepto, 'ortho'), 'Orthopedics', startsWith(claveDepto, 'em') || claveDepto == 'er', 'Emergency', startsWith(claveDepto, 'p'), 'Pediatrics', startsWith(claveDepto, 'onc'), 'Oncology', 'Unknown')) ~> normalizarDepartamento

normalizarDepartamento derive(admission_date = case(regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM-dd-yy'), regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'), regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]{2}, [0-9]{4}$'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy')),

discharge_date = case(regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM-dd-yy'), regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'), regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]{2}, [0-9]{4}$'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'))) ~> convertirFechas
convertirFechas derive(discharge_date = iif(discharge_date < admission_date, toDate(toString(null())), discharge_date)) ~> corregirAlta
